text: Never copy code from Zed's GPL terminal/terminal_view crates; learn architecture only, write the vt seam from rio-vt and alacritty_terminal APIs.
Any new code path that can write bytes to a pty must be listed in docs/security/terminal-input.md; MCP surfaces stay appearance-only.
Route every new UI string through app/src/lang.rs; it serves nine languages.
Keep pane render paths free of filesystem scans and image loads; render runs every frame across up to twenty panes.
Tests asserting lock releases, closes or async events must wait for them to land through the shared helper, not assert immediately.
Do not edit app/src/vendor/ (vendored unedited) or THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.md (generated by cargo about).
